description: Arcep created these population-point datasets to calculate mobile-network population coverage in seven French overseas territories. The provider distributes them for Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana, Réunion, Mayotte, Saint-Barthélemy and Saint-Martin. Census population is allocated to buildings larger than 20 square metres in proportion to building size. The documented fields identify building type, municipality code and allocated population. The source uses territory-specific projected coordinate systems. Public GeoJSON and archived Shapefile editions are listed under Licence Ouverte; links for the provider-labelled 2026 editions are retained. The provider warns about census and cadastral currency, unmodelled building use and the absence of IRIS subdivisions in Mayotte. These limitations affect mobile-coverage and capacity-planning calculations. No geometry or population values were downloaded. This explicitly documented telecom use supersedes the earlier generic-population rejection. The related Arcep mobile-network record provides the service context.
